purpose: Predeclared discovery screen of timed policies on two continuous calendar years; no fresh qualification holdout or automatic promotion
target: Shared bracket-policy net equity payoff, retaining cash and warmup on the full minute clock

hypotheses.rationale: Continuation of unusually strong four-bar moves relative to their trailing distribution
Reversal of unusually large one-bar moves relative to their trailing distribution
Continuation strengthened by volume relative to the trailing twenty-bar local distribution
New causal trend/pullback hypothesis: contrast twenty-bar price change with the most recent four bars; normalization/brackets unchanged; no independence claim

forward_diagnostics.selection: No automatic enrollment; first retain all outcomes and compare lead identity, rejection reasons and correlation with the existing fixed forward cohort

limitations: Rolling bar features cross session boundaries; four bars is not always one wall-clock hour
Not a replication of published first-half-hour/last-half-hour momentum
Local volume normalization is not a time-of-day seasonal model
Corrected raw bars do not establish point-in-time receipt or fill availability
Bracket OHLC full-fill assumptions exclude partial fills, queue position, borrow, funding, distributions and corporate actions
Triage is predeclared descriptive screening, not a calibrated statistical significance test
Each year is one continuous simulation with one initial warmup; chunk boundaries cannot reset pending orders, inventory, features or protection
Calendar years reset flat between independent diagnostic runs; compounded year returns are selected-run wealth, not an unbroken two-year account
2022 and 2023 are development history, potentially previously observed in daily research, not untouched qualification holdouts
The 5-minute resting and 24-hour elapsed holding intents are frozen before acquisition; no alternative duration will be tried in this campaign
At least 100 aggregate closed trades and both annual primary-cost returns positive are required; a pass grants only further research, not qualification
No parameter retuning, extra symbols, reruns after coverage failure or final holdout use
